title: ezdns records
description: DNS records of the ezdns Terraform module: a document with a records key, as passed through yamldecode

records.description: records[NAME][TYPE] = [RECORD, ...]; NAME is a name within the zone (@ for the apex)

additionalProperties.description: Record types, optionally with a prefix, e.g. _acme-challenge.TXT

ttl.description: TTL in seconds, 1 for automatic (default: default_ttl)

key.description: Stable key instead of the value in the record key, so changing the value updates the record in place

comment.description: Comment shown in the Cloudflare dashboard (default: default_comment)

ignore_changes.description: Attributes taken from the record in the zone instead of the configuration, for values changed outside Terraform (provider v5 only; the record is found by name and type)

private_routing.description: Private network routing to the origin (provider v5 only)
